newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia news agency corrects March export data.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia news agency corrects March export data.

text.p: Malaysia's national news agency Bernama said on Friday that exports rose 2.8 percent in March as the country posted a 1.75 billion ringgit trade surplus for that month.
The news agency, which has an exclusive right to distribute key economic data from the government, had earlier said exports had risen 28 percent year on year.
Exports in March 1997 were 18.680 billion against March 1996 exports of 18.179.
